approach: Traverse the string once to separate vowels and consonants into two lists, preserving original relative order.
observation: Consonants occupy even indices (0, 2, 4, ...) while vowels occupy odd indices (1, 3, 5, ...).
bruteForce: Collect vowels and consonants into dynamic lists or StringBuilder, then place them into a char array of length N.
optimalSolution: Use a single pass to collect or directly place consonants at even pointers (0, 2, 4...) and vowels at odd pointers (1, 3, 5...) in O(N) time and O(N) space.
dryRun: S='beauty'. Consonants=[b,t,y], Vowels=[e,a,u]. Result[0]=b, Result[1]=e, Result[2]=t, Result[3]=a, Result[4]=y, Result[5]=u -> 'betayu'.
